name: SeCar
description:
Project Overview:
I am planning to develop a modular, scalable, and high-performance car resale platform named "Se-Car." The platform will feature both dark and light themes and will allow users to register for free to sell their used cars. The website should be designed to be easily hosted and deployed, with GitHub as the version control system. Access to admin-related pages will be restricted to logged-in users only, and proper logging for APIs will be implemented to ensure transparency and ease of debugging.
Modules:
Login/Signup:
Users and Admins can register and log in using email and password with basic info.
Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
Admin Panel:
Manage Cars: CRUD operations for car listings.
Review & Approve User Requests: Approve or reject user requests to post their cars.
Review & Approve Test Drive Requests: Manage user requests for test drives.
User Dashboard:
Track Test Drive Requests: View and manage test drive requests.
Post Free Ads: Submit requests to post free car ads.
Wishlist: Save favorite cars.
Recently Viewed Cars: Track recently viewed cars.
Cart/Order:
Users can add cars to the cart and purchase them by clicking the "Buy Now" button.
Implement secure payment gateways and order management.
Signout:
Secure logout functionality to ensure user security.
technicalDetails:
Tech Stack:
Front-End:
Vue.js
Tailwind CSS
Vite.js
Axios
Back-End:
.NET Core 8 Web API
MVC
Swagger for API documentation
CORS for cross-origin resource sharing
Database:
PostgreSQL
ORM:
AutoMapper
EFCore
Requirements:
Modular Architecture: Ensure the platform is modular to facilitate easy updates and maintenance.
Scalability: Design the system to handle increased traffic and data volume.
Performance: Optimize for fast load times and smooth user experience.
Security: Implement robust security measures to protect user data and transactions.
Responsive Design: Ensure the platform is fully responsive and works well on all devices.
Version Control: Use GitHub for version control and collaboration.
API Logging: Implement proper logging for APIs to track requests and responses for debugging and monitoring purposes.
